title: 第514章 银翼城第513章 五天后的处决仪式
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
马车车厢内，气氛有些沉闷。
缇亚娜换回了那身银色的元帅铠甲，端坐在肖恩的对面，闭着眼睛，似乎在养神，但紧握的长剑却暴露了她内心的不平静。
肖恩则悠闲得多，他靠在柔软的椅背上，手里把玩着那枚从缇亚娜发间取下的枯叶，饶有兴致地看着窗外的风景。
“元帅大人，”肖恩忽然开口，打破了沉默，“你好像很紧张。”
缇亚娜睁开眼睛，冰蓝色的眸子冷冷地看着他，没有说话。
“其实你不用这么紧张，”肖恩将那片枯叶放在鼻尖闻了闻，继续说道，“我不是说过了吗？我是来帮忙的。”
“帮我？”
“你想怎么帮？”
肖恩笑了笑，“这个世界上只有一种人能得到我的免费帮助。”
“还有一种人能让我舍弃生命的帮助。”
“你想听哪一种？”
缇亚娜犹豫了一下：“第一种是什么人？”
“是那些饱受磨难和压力的成熟女人们，但前提是单身。”
缇亚娜一脸无语，肖恩的嘴里果然吐不出什么好话。
“那另外一种呢？”
“我的女人。”
“缇亚娜元帅，你想不想让我舍弃生命的帮助你？”
缇亚娜紧咬银牙，那眼神恨不得要邦邦给他两拳头。
肖恩见状笑了笑，“即使不满足第二种情况，看在第一种情况的份上，我还是可以帮助你的。”
“关于塞拉斯，你还知道些什么？”缇亚娜终于忍不住，问出了那个在她心里盘旋了一整夜的问题。

她知道，问出这个问题的瞬间，自己就已经落入了下风。
肖恩看着她，脸上的笑意更深了。
他喜欢看她这副样子。
明明心里已经慌得不行，却还要故作镇定。
“知道得太多，会睡不着的。”他慢悠悠地说。
在缇亚娜即将发作的眼神中，他话锋一转。
“元帅大人，你只需要知道，五天后，雄狮广场会很热闹。”
肖恩的身体微微前倾，凑近了一些，声音压低了几分，带着一种奇异的蛊惑。
“而我，是来帮你收拾烂摊子的。”
“当然，不是免费和收费是两种截然不同的效果。”
他看着缇亚娜那双因震惊而微微睁大的蓝色眼睛。
微微一笑。
车厢里陷入了长久的沉默。
缇亚娜没有回答肖恩最后那个问题，只是将头转向了一边，看着窗外飞速倒退的景色。
她在生气，但又不仅仅是生气。
肖恩也不再说话，靠在椅背上，闭着眼睛，像是在休息。
马车在国王大道上平稳地行驶着，这条路是德玛西亚的交通主脉，路面用巨大的石板铺就，即使是高速行驶，车厢内也感觉不到太大的颠簸。
然而，意外总是在不经意间发生。
车轮似乎碾过了一块松动的石板，整个车厢猛地向一侧剧烈倾斜了一下。
“唔……”

缇亚娜正对着窗外出神，完全没有防备。
这一下突然的倾斜让她身体一歪，整个人不受控制地朝着肖恩的方向倒了过去。
她冰蓝色的眼睛里闪过一丝错愕。
作为一名身经百战的元帅，称号级的强者，这种程度的颠簸本不该让她如此失态。
content_en:
Inside the carriage, the atmosphere was a bit dull.
Tiana changed back into the silver marshal's armor and sat opposite Sean. She closed her eyes and seemed to be recuperating, but the sword she was holding tightly revealed her inner peace.
Sean was much more leisurely. He leaned back on the soft chair, playing with the dead leaf taken from Tiana's hair, and looking at the scenery outside the window with interest.
"Marshal," Sean suddenly spoke, breaking the silence, "you seem to be very nervous."
Tiana opened her eyes and looked at him coldly with her icy blue eyes without speaking.
"Actually, you don't have to be so nervous," Sean put the dead leaf to the tip of his nose, smelled it, and continued, "Didn't I say it before? I'm here to help."
“帮我？”
“你想怎么帮？”
Sean smiled, "There is only one kind of person in this world who can get my free help."
"There is one more person who can help me to give up my life."
"Which one do you want to hear?"
Tiana hesitated: "Who is the first type?"
"They are mature women who have suffered hardships and pressure, but only if they are single."
Tiana was speechless, and Sean really had nothing good to say.
"What about the other one?"
“我的女人。”
"Marshal Tiana, do you want me to risk my life to help you?"
Tiana clenched her silver teeth, her eyes wishing for Bang Bang to give him two fists.
Sean smiled when he saw this, "Even if you don't meet the second situation, for the sake of the first situation, I can still help you."
"What else do you know about Silas?" Tiana finally couldn't help but asked the question that had been swirling in her mind all night.
She knew that the moment she asked this question, she was already at a disadvantage.
Sean looked at her, and the smile on his face deepened.
He liked seeing her like this.
Even though he was extremely panicked, he still pretended to be calm.
"If you know too much, you won't be able to sleep." He said slowly.
Seeing Tiana's eyes about to have an attack, he changed the topic.
"Marshal, you just need to know that in five days, Lion Square will be very busy."
Sean's body leaned forward slightly, getting closer, and his voice was lowered a bit, with a strange kind of bewitchment.
"And I'm here to help you clean up your mess."
"Of course, free and paid are two completely different effects."
He looked at Tiana's blue eyes that were slightly widened in shock.
Smile slightly.
There was a long silence in the carriage.
Tiana did not answer Sean's last question, but turned her head to the side and looked at the rapidly retreating scenery outside the window.
She was angry, but not just angry.
Sean stopped talking and leaned back in the chair with his eyes closed, as if he was resting.
The carriage drove smoothly on the King's Road, which was the main traffic artery of Demacia. The road was paved with huge stone slabs. Even at high speed, there was no big bump in the carriage.
However, accidents always happen unexpectedly.
The wheels seemed to have run over a loose stone slab, and the entire carriage tilted violently to one side.
"Well..."
Tiana was lost in thought looking out the window, completely unprepared.
This sudden tilt caused her body to tilt, and she fell uncontrollably in the direction of Sean.
A trace of astonishment flashed in her ice-blue eyes.
As a marshal who has experienced hundreds of battles and a title-level expert, this level of turbulence should not have made her lose her composure.
